evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/net.cpp and src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to expose cpu_load in getpeerinfo and -netinfo.
rationale: The PR adds a new `cpu_load` metric to `getpeerinfo` and `bitcoin-cli -netinfo` to allow node operators to monitor peer CPU consumption. The author notes that "monitoring CPU usage is useful on its own" and reviewers agree it is "useful for detecting attackers in an actual DoS attack" (mzumsande) and as a "first step for anti-DoS measures" (laanwj), though it represents an unrequested diagnostic field that is reasonably deferrable.
